title: Harmonic descriptors app (Harmonic Descriptors Implementation)

author.name: gamaievsky
author.field: Musicology / music information retrieval (spectral analysis of harmony in audio recordings)

provenance.origin: github.com/gamaievsky/Web_app_descriptors at 24f538de3f06, personal (personal: "my PhD" dash in:readme archived:false (page 1))

notes: Found in a public repository and run by a computer-use agent (batch public-1). Computes CQT-based static and dynamic harmonic descriptors (such as roughness, harmonicity, concordance and harmonic change) for each hand-segmented chord of one or more audio excerpts, and plots any two of them against each other as a map of points or trajectories. Data used in the run: synthetic. tree.json is the workflow the agent did and a second agent replayed; run.json says how.
